# Precious Beauty

> Hair salon and African braider in Bergamo, Italy, run by Precious (Precious Beauty di Omoruyi Precious). Braids, cornrows, twists, locs, haircuts for men, women and children, and eyelash extensions. Booking by WhatsApp. Spoken languages: Italian, English, German, French, Spanish.

## Location and hours

- Address: Via Paleocapa 8/B, 24122 Bergamo (BG), Italy
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:00–20:00, Sunday 10:00–20:00
- Phone and WhatsApp: +39 371 578 0893 (https://wa.me/393715780893)
- VAT number: IT04902180167

## Prices (EUR, final prices)

- Haircut: 15
- Children's haircut: 10
- Colouring and haircut: from 25
- Braids: from 25 (final price depends on length, size and style; send a photo on WhatsApp for a quote)
- Eyelash extensions: from 20
- Shave: 7
- Hair wash: 7
- Hair retouch: 15

## Styles

- Women: faux locs, knotless braids (small / medium / large / jumbo), triangle-part box braids, braids with beads, boho / goddess bob braids, Senegalese and rope twists, cornrow half-up with curly ponytail, kids Dutch braids, tapered natural cut with design, lashes (classic / hybrid / volume)
- Men: box braids with fade, top knot and man bun braids, triangle and square-part plaits, plaits with beads, freestyle and stitch cornrows, feed-in cornrows, interlocked locs, sponge twists, waves, fades and line designs
